plainTranslation: A's structure meets B's drive. The sextile supports them, if you act on it.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
note: Synced from authored synastry bundle synastry-authored__19_ (2).json.
summaryDeep: Their standards, caution, and sense of responsibility work smoothly with your drive, timing, and willingness to act. It runs easily and asks little, quietly steadying the rest of the bond. Lean on how naturally this one lines up.
tension: The challenge is that caution can quietly turn into avoidance. You may find yourself endlessly preparing, analyzing, or addressing one concern after another until you lose touch with the original goal. On the other side, you may dismiss their input before fully considering it because receiving guidance feels uncomfortable or limiting.
advice: Discipline is useful when it helps you move forward. It is a problem when it becomes an excuse to do nothing.
summaryShort: Their standards, caution, and sense of responsibility work smoothly with your drive, timing, and willingness to act.
